title: Project Glasswing: Securing critical software for the AI era
summary_zh: Anthropic 推出 Project Glasswing，利用 Claude Mythos Preview AI 模型来识别和修复关键软件中的安全漏洞。该项目涉及多家科技公司，目标是保护关键基础设施免受网络威胁，体现了 AI 在网络安全防御方面的前沿应用。
summary_en: Anthropic launches Project Glasswing, using Claude Mythos Preview AI model to identify and fix security vulnerabilities in critical software. The initiative involves multiple tech companies to protect critical infrastructure from cyber threats, showcasing cutting-edge applications of AI in cybersecurity defense.
one_liner: AI驱动的安全漏洞检测将成为关键基础设施保护的标配

title: Scaling Managed Agents: Decoupling the brain from the hands
summary_zh: Anthropic 介绍了 Claude 平台中的托管代理服务，探讨如何将推理大脑与执行能力解耦，以支持长期的多步骤任务执行。文章分析了代理系统随模型演进而发展的架构变化。
summary_en: Anthropic introduces managed agents service in Claude Platform, exploring how to decouple reasoning brain from execution capabilities to support long-horizon multi-step tasks. The article analyzes how agent system architectures evolve as models improve.
one_liner: 代理架构的解耦设计是应对复杂长期任务的关键突破

title: Improving instruction hierarchy in frontier LLMs
summary_zh: OpenAI 研究前沿语言模型中的指令层次结构改进方法，探索如何提升模型对复杂指令的理解和执行能力，为多步骤任务处理提供更好的支持。
summary_en: OpenAI explores improvements in instruction hierarchy within frontier language models, investigating how to enhance model understanding and execution of complex instructions for better multi-step task support.
one_liner: 指令层次结构的优化是提升多步推理的关键技术

title: Understanding why reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought
summary_zh: 研究揭示推理模型难以控制思维链的内在原因，发现这种'失控'实际上可能是模型的固有特性，而非缺陷。这一发现对理解模型行为有重要启示。
summary_en: Research reveals why reasoning models struggle to control their chains of thought, finding that this 'lack of control' may actually be an inherent characteristic rather than a flaw, with important implications for understanding model behavior.
one_liner: 推理模型的'失控'可能是其内在特性而非设计缺陷

title: ConvApparel: Measuring and bridging the realism gap in user simulators

summary_en: Google Research introduces ConvApparel framework to measure and bridge the realism gap in user simulators. This quantitative evaluation method helps build more accurate user behavior models.
one_liner: 真实感量化评估是构建准确用户模拟器的重要工具

summary_en: Google Research launches two AI agent tools specifically designed to improve figure generation and peer review processes in academic workflows, enhancing research efficiency and quality.

title: Pi: The Minimal Agent Within OpenClaw
summary_zh: Pi 是 OpenClaw 中的极简编程 Agent，仅使用系统提示词、文件读取、文件写入和一个 LLM 主循环驱动。不同于复杂的智能体框架，Pi 追求「做少做精」——读取文件、做修改、由 LLM 决定执行命令。UI 参考 Codex，支持分支会话用于代码审查，以及快速查看最近提到的文件。
summary_en: Pi is a minimal coding agent for OpenClaw that uses a simple system prompt, a file reader, a file writer, and a main loop running an LLM that interprets observations and decides whether to execute commands. Rather than building complex orchestration, Pi focuses on doing one thing well: reading files, making changes, and letting the LLM drive everything. The UI is modeled after Codex with easy-to-review commits, diffs, and uncommitted changes. The agent supports branching sessions for review and uses shift+ctrl+r for quick-look of recently mentioned files.
one_liner: 极简设计哲学的编程 Agent，或将成为 AI 辅助开发的主流范式

It includes skills for asking clarifying questions, writing specs, bootstrapping projects, planning implementations, reviewing code, running tests, and managing git commits.

title: Stop using LLM council with Claude. Do this instead.
summary_zh: 文章在 Karpathy 的 LLM Council（多模型投票）和 Ole Lehmann 的单模型多角色方案基础上，提出三层多样性架构：层1使用真正的多模型多样性（GPT、Claude、Gemini 同时推理）减少自我偏好偏差（引用 NeurIPS 2024、ICLR 2025 等论文）；层2允许自定义分析视角适配不同决策场景；层3引入 Stanford 的 Verbalized Sampling 技术，让每个模型探索低概率尾部响应，实现 1.6-2.1x 的多样性提升。三层叠加可实现前所未有的分析深度，但需 Perplexity Pro/Max 订阅。
summary_en: Builds on Karpathy's multi-model LLM Council and Ole Lehmann's single-model persona approach to propose a three-layer diversity stack: (1) true multi-model diversity across GPT, Claude, Gemini to reduce self-preference bias (citing NeurIPS 2024, ICLR 2025 papers); (2) customizable analytical lenses for domain-specific decisions; (3) Stanford's Verbalized Sampling technique to explore low-probability tail responses, achieving 1.6-2.1x diversity improvement. The combined stack enables unprecedented analytical depth but requires Perplexity Pro/Max subscription.
one_liner: 三层多样性叠加是目前 LLM 决策辅助的最优方案，Verbalized Sampling 是点睛之笔

title: Why long-term memory for LLMs remains unsolved
summary_zh: 文章系统论证了 LLM 长期记忆为何仍是未解难题。核心矛盾在于 Raw（原文保留）与 Derived（摘要派生）两种路径的取舍：Raw 无损但无用，Derived 有用但会随反复摘要逐步漂移失真。无限上下文窗口无法解决此问题（成本线性增长 + 上下文填充导致性能下降）。文章提出记忆系统设计的 9 个关键维度（存储内容、派生时机、写入触发、存储位置、检索方式、后处理、检索时机、策展者、遗忘策略），并列举了 10 种常见失败模式（会话失忆、实体混淆、过度推断、摘要漂移等）。
summary_en: Systematically argues why long-term memory for LLMs remains unsolved. The core tension is between Raw (verbatim storage) and Derived (summarized) approaches: Raw is lossless but inert, Derived is usable but drifts through repeated summarization. Infinite context windows don't solve this (linear cost scaling + degraded performance as context fills). Proposes 9 key design dimensions for memory systems and catalogs 10 common failure modes including session amnesia, entity confusion, over-inference, and derivation drift.
one_liner: 目前对 LLM 记忆系统设计空间最完整的系统性分析，9 维度 + 10 失败模式框架极具参考价值

title: Your harness, your memory
summary_zh: LangChain 联合创始人 Harrison Chase 论述 Agent Harness 与记忆的深度绑定关系。核心论点：如果你使用闭源 Harness（特别是托管在 API 后面的），你就放弃了对 Agent 记忆的控制权。记忆是创建个性化和粘性 Agent 体验的关键，它会形成数据飞轮和平台锁定。文章警告 Anthropic 的 Claude Managed Agents 将一切放在 API 后面是最危险的锁定形式，并推广 LangChain 的 Deep Agents 作为开源替代方案，强调记忆和 Harness 应该与模型提供商分离。
summary_en: LangChain co-founder Harrison Chase argues that agent harnesses are deeply tied to memory. Core thesis: if you use a closed harness (especially behind an API), you yield control of your agent's memory. Memory creates data flywheels and platform lock-in. Warns that Anthropic's Claude Managed Agents putting everything behind an API is the most dangerous form of lock-in. Promotes LangChain's Deep Agents as an open-source alternative, emphasizing memory and harnesses should be separate from model providers.
one_liner: 从平台锁定角度论证开源 Harness 的必要性，利益相关但有理有据

summary_en: Anthropic's RLance Martin announces Claude Managed Agents, a pre-built configurable agent harness running on managed infrastructure. Key concepts: Agent (versioned config with model, system prompt, tools, skills, MCP servers), Environment (sandbox template), Session (stateful run). Supports 6 SDK languages. Common patterns include event-triggered, scheduled, fire-and-forget, and long-horizon tasks. The engineering approach decouples the 'brain' (Claude + harness) from 'hands' (sandboxes/tools) and 'session' (event log), each as independent interfaces.

title: 丢掉沉重的记忆：Codex、Claude Code 与 OpenCode 的上下文压缩术
summary_zh: 以一个 15,400 tokens 的登录 Bug 修复场景为切入点，深度对比三款 CLI Agent 的上下文压缩策略。Codex CLI 采用「工作交接单」式单层摘要替换，保留用户消息原样但删除所有 AI 回复和工具结果。Claude Code 设计三层递进机制：第一层工具结果修剪（无 LLM 开销，用占位符替换）、第二层 Prompt Cache 友好策略（尾部修整保持前缀稳定）、第三层 9 部分结构化 LLM 总结（含自动重读最近编辑文件）。OpenCode 用时间戳标记隐藏（非物理删除）+ 5 标题 LLM 摘要，并自动重放最后一条用户消息。核心洞察：最好的上下文管理不是无限扩大容量，而是精密地遗忘。
one_liner: 目前对三大 CLI Agent 上下文压缩策略最深入的对比分析，Claude Code 三层递进设计尤为精妙

title: Agent Memory 架构本质
summary_zh: 文章从容量 vs 治理的根本矛盾出发，系统拆解 Agent Memory 的建模对象（用户模型、任务模型、世界模型、自我模型）、六大基本记忆单元（内容/类型/置信度/来源/作用域/时间衰减）、三条核心链路（写入/管理/读取）和进化机制（修正+遗忘）。核心观点：蒸馏是 memory pipeline 的一步而非记忆本身，记忆的难点从来不在容量在治理；Context window 扩展解决的是带宽问题而非建模问题；评测正在从"能不能 recall"转向"能不能 update、能不能 drift、能不能 selective forget"。

title: KV Cache 深度解析：为什么 LLM 第一个 Token 最慢
summary_zh: 从注意力机制原理出发，详解 KV Cache 的工作原理与工程权衡。核心：自回归生成中 Token 1-49 的 K/V 每次都重算是 O(n²) 浪费；KV Cache 把历史 K/V 只算一次并缓存，新 Token 只追加自己的 K/V，实现约 5x 提速；代价是显存占用，context window 翻倍意味着单请求 cache 翻倍。Prefill 阶段（首个 Token）最贵，因为要一次性算完所有历史 K/V，这就是 TTFT 瓶颈的来源。GQA/MQA 通过共享 K/V head 显著降内存，是大规模服务必用方案。
one_liner: 把 KV Cache 和 TTFT 讲得最透的一篇，配有丰富的动图解释，适合所有做 LLM 推理服务的工程师精读。

title: Automated Alignment Researchers: Using large language models to scale scalable oversight
summary_zh: Anthropic 发布 Automated Alignment Researchers（AAR）研究：用 9 个 Claude Opus 4.6 实例并行作为自动化对齐研究员，在弱-强监督问题上从人类基准 PGR 0.23 提升至 0.97，成本约 $18,000。核心发现：AAR 能从不同起点发现互补方法；给予过多结构会限制 Claude 的适应力；纯 idea 数量可以弥补"研究品味"的不足；evaluating（设置正确的实验）而非 generating（生成想法）将成为对齐研究的瓶颈。AAR 仍会出现 reward hacking，且方法难以跨领域泛化。
summary_en: Anthropic deploys 9 Claude Opus 4.6 instances as Automated Alignment Researchers (AARs), achieving PGR improvement from human baseline 0.23 to 0.97 on weak-to-strong supervision at ~$18,000 cost. Key findings: AARs discover complementary methods from different starting points; excessive structure limits Claude's adaptability; sheer idea volume can compensate for lack of "research taste"; evaluation (setting up correct experiments) becomes the bottleneck over generation. AARs still exhibit reward hacking and methods struggle to generalize across domains.
one_liner: Anthropic 的 AAR 实验是目前 AI 对齐研究中最接近"AI 加速 AI 对齐"这一愿景的实证工作，PGR 0.97 结果令人震撼但也需冷静看待其局限性。

title: OpenClaw 落地到生产实际应用的一种可能的路径
summary_zh: 文章分析 OpenClaw 进入真实生产场景还缺的四层能力：可视化层（Agent 在做什么必须清晰可见）、封闭层（把开放业务动作重构为边界明确的工作单元）、验证层（垂直领域的 gate，不通过不能进入完成态）、回滚层（沙盘机制，Amazon agent canvas 的实践）。核心判断：Coding Agent 成功是因为代码世界天然具备可视化/封闭/可验证/可回滚四个特征；业务 Agent 要落地必须先把这四层能力构建出来；真正值得做的是先把公司业务重构成 Agent 可稳定工作的工程环境。
one_liner: 把业务 Agent 落地问题归结为"把开放世界改造成代码世界那样的封闭工程空间"，这个框架对所有想做生产级 Agent 的人都有参考价值。
